mechanisms.name: Nishchal Jain Herd Composition & Care Optimization
mechanisms.author: Nishchal Jain (nishchaljainds)
mechanisms.exact_mechanism: Mix optimization over total headcount. Evaluated livestock scaling in kaggriculture simulation; discovered that 9 sheep represented a sharp local optimum while adding indiscriminate extra animals (e.g., 7 cows + 7 sheep) depressed returns due to feed consumption and price-curve cliff effects. Demonstrated that daily CARE action yields ~4.25x multiplier on sheep lifetime output and ~3.27x on cow lifetime output.
mechanisms.reported_metric: Public LB score progression; sharp margin peak at 9 sheep vs baseline 6 sheep; documented price collapse when wool/milk exceeds market absorption

mechanisms.name: Yusuke Hayashi Dynamic Shop Router (EXP173 / shop-router-0911-simple)
mechanisms.author: Yusuke Hayashi (yhay81)
mechanisms.exact_mechanism: Pre-computed static action tapes conditioned on opening shop pairings (Step 144 / Day 6 shop unlocks). Exploits Step 0 wheat wash liquidity float to fund Day 1 immediate hire of 5 hands, 2 cows, and 2 sheep. Selects specialized route branches based on shop demand patterns.
mechanisms.reported_metric: Leaderboard 2720+ -> 2945+; stabilized multi-worker coordination on pre-tilled farm tiles

mechanisms.name: Rayk Kretzschmar Atomic Funded Opening (Rank Your Agent lineage)

mechanisms.name: Live Meta Replay Snapshot Composition (9C + 4S + 1W + 10H)
mechanisms.author: Frontier Public Ladder Cluster (Top-20 / Top-30 Replay Forensics)
mechanisms.population: Top-30 Public Ladder Match Replays (3100+ Elo cohort)
mechanisms.exact_mechanism: Reallocated capital composition maintaining exactly 9 Cows, 4 Sheep, 1 dedicated internal Wheat rotation, and 10 Hired Hands. Shifts pasture allocation to prioritize high-compounding cow milk while bounding sheep wool production below town saturation limits.
mechanisms.reported_metric: 3100+ Elo competitive survival; terminal wealth exceeding $130,000 on standard seeds

mechanisms.name: Shared Barn Entrance & Shed Access Desynchronization
mechanisms.author: Kaggriculture Meta Research Community & V51 Loss Forensics
mechanisms.exact_mechanism: Centralized shed access at coordinates (4,4)-(5,5) creates spatial movement contention when farmer and multiple hands attempt simultaneous DROP/PICKUP operations or cross paths at door bottlenecks. Movement blocking causes downstream action failures on fixed action tapes.
mechanisms.reported_metric: Attributed to 2/11 historical V49 losses (Seed 250416, -$716 delta); turn wasted metrics during midday harvest windows
